summary: Frontend-only validation of (1) Theme presets in Colours & Fonts modal and (2) superadmin '+ Add section' flow on the home page editor. All acceptance criteria passed. wifetobe left CLEAN (theme reset + inserted CTA section undone).
critical_code_review_comments: SectionPicker fetches /api/sections on every open with no loading guard beyond a 'Loading…' string — fine, but items load async so any automated click needs to wait for section-<key> testid to be visible before asserting. Consider disabling the whole picker until items load.
seed_data_creation: None. Test inserted an ivds-cta section on wifetobe/home and then undid it. Theme was changed to BoldModern/WarmBoutique/ClassicElegant during test and then reset via theme-reset (backend returned 200 and DELETE'd the theme override — GET /api/theme/wifetobe now 404 = site defaults, matches the 'Theme reset to the site's original look' toast).
context_for_next_testing_agent: THEME PRESETS: all four presets (ClassicElegant, BoldModern, WarmBoutique, FreshClean) visible in ThemeModal, clicking each updates theme-preview innerHTML (fonts+accent) live. theme-save produced toast 'Theme saved — open a page or hit Preview to see it'. theme-reset produced 'Theme reset to the site's original look' and GET /api/theme/wifetobe returns 404 (no override -> defaults). ADD SECTION (superadmin): editor-add-section button is present on the editor topbar; section-picker opens listing 6 cards (cta/split/features/banner/quote/heading). Clicking section-cta closes picker within ~3s and iframe reloads. Fetch of /api/editor/page/wifetobe/home confirmed ivds-cta present, 'Ready to get started' heading present, SECTIONS_CSS (ivds-feature-grid) injected, and data-eid attributes present (section is click-to-edit). editor-undo removed ivds-cta (verified via same fetch: hasCta:false). Superadmin gating: NOT executed as a negative test (documented in original request as optional; add-section is gated by user.role === 'superadmin' in App.js and only rendered in Editor if user is superadmin). Final state on wifetobe: theme reset to defaults; home page has no ivds-cta remnants.
